alarm_in_isolation: perl -e '$SIG{ALRM}=sub{die "A\n"}; my $t=time; alarm 1; eval { 1 while time - $t < 5 }; print "got: $@"; print "waited ", time-$t' -> got: A, waited 1 (the time() call enters the dispatcher, whose hint check fetches the signal)
perl -e '$SIG{ALRM}=sub{die "A\n"}; alarm 1; eval { sleep 5 }; print "got: $@"' -> got: A

method: one guest boot (signals-boot.sh platform); unittest -v runs of test.test_signal and test.test_faulthandler; every error is classified by the library frame that raised it; Perl tests run one at a time because a hung test has no in-guest timeout
notes: every test_signal error is an unserved clone (subprocess), socket or thread start; no signal assertion failed
subprocess.Popen uses _posixsubprocess.fork_exec (clone); the port patch that routes it through posix_spawn is docs/plans/delegation-abi.md's CPython item, not this branch
epoll_create1 (20) is unserved and shows in every CPython run's unserved list; selectors falls back for the tested paths

os.posix_spawnp with setsigdef/setsigmask, sigtimedwait with si_pid and si_status, set_wakeup_fd, faulthandler.enable, alarm and setitimer against sleep and blocking read, KeyboardInterrupt from SIGINT all pass in the smoke
